top_choice_rationale: P001 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clocks) rests on a distinct, experimentally reproduced achievement: magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms that removes the light shift and motional effects, realised at 10^-18 fractional uncertainty and confirmed across JILA, RIKEN/Tokyo, PTB, SYRTE and NIST. It is not already covered by the 2005 comb prize or the 2012 single-quantum-system prize, the two names match origin and realisation of the concept, and the citation is limited to what has been demonstrated. No award is the only alternative and I rank it below a mature, well-attributed achievement.
